definitions: A cultivated plant, especially a cereal, fruit, or vegetable, grown on a large scale as food, fodder, or for commercial use.
The total amount of a crop harvested in a particular season or place.
A riding whip with a loop at one end.
A pouch-like part of the gullet of a bird or insect, in which food is stored for digestion or for regurgitation to young.
examples: The main crop grown in this region is wheat.
We had a good crop of apples this year.
